escenas.texto: This week in Africa, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over one hundred and seventy-one million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Wednesday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from Tunisia, ZARUFA FF, with a video posted one day ago. Over four hundred and sixty-four thousand views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A video over one hundred and forty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Number nine, 𝗟𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗟𝗼𝗱𝘀, with “Spider-Man’s Epic Swing Through New York! Marvel’s Spider-Man 2”. Over five hundred and forty-four thousand views. A video over sixty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.
Number eight, Techys, with “We Used HACKS in Roblox Huss Valley...”. Over five hundred and sixty-six thousand views. It also has five hundred and seventeen comments.

Number seven, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video posted five days ago. Over one million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over thirty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Number six, from Algeria, Fawajir - فواجر , with a video posted one day ago. Over one million views. It got there in just one day. It also has over two thousand likes.

Next up, number five, from Senegal, Marodi TV Sénégal, with a video posted four days ago. Over one point four million views. A video over thirty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over one thousand comments.

In position number four, from Egypt, Mahmoud Zayed - محمود زايد, with a video posted six days ago. Over three point two million views. A Short of just twenty-three seconds. It also has over eleven thousand comments.

Bronze medal, SalesBendagra, with “Part 4, Subscribe For More.”. Over ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about ninety-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over two thousand comments.
Silver medal, from South Africa, Ryan HD, with “School VS Adult VS College.”. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just ten seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.

And finally, number one most viewed, Sophie cindy, with “My daily duty as a mom of 5”. Over thirty million views.
